title: TensorPlate Buffer Pressure Event
description:
Memory-pressure transition emitted by the v0.1.0 CPU buffer plane. Carries the same fields a metrics scrape would expose, plus the previous/current pressure level so consumers can audit transitions without resampling. Mirrors include/tensorplate/buffer/buffer_manager.hpp::BufferPressureEvent.

v0.1.0 records these only on level changes (Normal -> Warning, Warning -> Critical, etc.). The exact threshold policy is configurable; defaults are warning >= 75 %, critical >= 90 % of capacity.

This schema intentionally does NOT carry raw memory addresses, request payloads, or per-request labels. Observability work in V01-E12 wires per-endpoint labels above this layer.

pool_name.description: Stable, low-cardinality buffer-pool label (`BufferManagerConfig::pool_name`). Snake_case recommended.

capacity_bytes.description: Configured `BufferManagerConfig::capacity_bytes` at the time of the event.

in_use_bytes.description: Sum of `size_bytes` across active buffers at the time of the event.

high_water_bytes.description: High-water mark of `in_use_bytes` since manager construction.

allocation_failures.description: Monotonically increasing count of allocation failures attributable to pressure (capacity-exceeded or allocator bad_alloc). Validation rejections (zero-byte, alignment) are NOT counted; they are caller bugs, not pressure.
